decisions.reason: The encrypted secondary channel is central to the firm's announced security direction, so management will hold to its investment and attribute weak early results to market ramp-up.
Mobile PDF signing fits the firm's publicly committed digital signature portfolio, and one year on the market is too short to abandon it.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is the core of the firm's strategy and its most visible commitment, which makes dropping it very unlikely.
The email-to-app delivery robot is more peripheral, but the resources already invested and its link to the secure messaging line justify continuing it for now.
The hardware token involves sunk development and production costs and supports the signature offering, so management will persist despite niche demand.
The payment security compliance suite serves ongoing regulatory needs, so disappointing early uptake can still be attributed to temporary causes.
